source.paraphrase: Structured saga construction requires a nonempty sagaType and sagaId and the injected IDKernel.

invariants.why: Empty identities reject construction before subscriptions or work can start. Primitive kernel values cannot supply the runtime gates.
invariants.fixHint: Use the public DStructuredSaga constructor with both stable nonempty IDs and the factory's injected kernel. The API is deprecated but remains valid in the pinned release; do not replace its DSL with a dependency lookup that has no registered provider.
invariants.avoid: Reserved DStructuredSaga constructor-name policy in reviewed paths, not import/type identity inference. Covers direct identifier, dot/literal-bracket constructor names and transparent wrappers; missing required arguments, directly blank string IDs and known invalid literal ID/kernel types. Explicit invalid arguments before the first spread remain checked; leading spreads leave later positions unresolved. Dynamic values, escaped blank IDs, aliases and actual kernel shape/ownership are unresolved. Bare undefined uses a direct-value policy; lexical shadow resolution is not proved. Does not certify persistence, queue overrides, graph/lifecycle or correlation. Required DSL construction is not itself a collaborator bypass; review managed-path scope instead of banning a public library construction.

source.paraphrase: Steps require stepId, on and a Promise-compatible handler; joins require stepId, any/every mode and a nonempty expectedStepIds collection with unique references.

invariants.why: Missing fields reject registration; truthy noncallable handlers fail only during delivery. Awaiting a generator object does not run its body. Duplicate join references reject start because a join must track each expected step once. Public kind/callback/boolean contracts are stricter than this runtime's truthiness checks.
invariants.fixHint: Declare one valid step or join with a stable nonempty stepId. Use a callable handler that returns a Promise; use any/every and nonempty unique string step references for joins. Keep start/stop, duplicate IDs, reference existence, matching saga context, compensation and queue persistence under a project graph/runtime verifier.
invariants.avoid: Reserved registerNode method-name policy in reviewed paths, not receiver type inference. Direct dot/literal-bracket/optional calls, transparent wrappers and plain inline objects are covered. Later literal/shorthand keys win. Primitive DTOs, missing fields, known invalid literal field types, unknown literal kinds/modes, blank IDs/events and generator handlers are rejected. A trailing argument spread cannot replace an explicit first node; leading argument spreads remain unresolved. Bare undefined uses a direct-value policy; lexical shadow resolution is not proved. Dynamic fields/kinds, named callback types, Promise/return-flow correctness, escaped strings/keys, spreads, computed keys, getters, methods and prototypes are unresolved. Blank branchId is valid: upstream defaults it. Identical unescaped literal references with the same quote form are checked within one array, including explicit duplicates beside an argument/element spread. Mixed quote forms, escapes, interpolated templates and dynamic value equality remain unresolved. Duplicate/cross-call node IDs, reference existence, lifecycle, cancellation/checkpoint and persistence are not proved by syntax. No general same-named API ownership or complete saga compliance is inferred.
